experiment: Experiment 8 — MSDF Black Morphology Alignment Ablation

groups.G1: Frozen original MSDF Black; morphology alignment ON; gamma=1
groups.G2: New MSDF-NoMorph Black; morphology alignment OFF; gamma=1

training.budget_unit: 2000 successful optimizer updates per class; attempted updates and AMP skips recorded separately
training.trainable_parameter_dtype: float32 master parameters; never FP16 optimizer gradients
training.loss: unweighted ordinary denoising MSE; target determined by public base training scheduler prediction_type

prompts.flash: a photo of a sks flash defect
prompts.black: a photo of a sks black spot defect

training.training_order: annotation IDs sorted; deterministic per-class permutation seed42 + zero-based epoch
training.augmentation: none; deterministic geometric crop and hard rectangular mask
training.normal_background_policy: no extra normal-only generator training; masked donor crop is the denoising condition; frozen TRAIN normals only at inference
training.checkpoint_save_rule: final pipeline only after 2000 successful updates; no validation checkpoint selection
training.final_checkpoint_rule: class final_step2000 pipeline; hash all components; refuse if successful updates !=2000

mask_crop_policy.mask: L-mode rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive right/bottom
mask_crop_policy.mask_semantics: white inpaint, black retain; weak bbox geometry NOT segmentation ground truth
mask_crop_policy.output: paste generated 512 patch into the same full normal canvas at fixed crop origin; ignore padded pixels, no blending or quality selection
mask_crop_policy.synthetic_labels: only frozen target bbox; background normal has no dataset-defined boxes

training.entrypoint: train_dreambooth_noise.py, pinned by Stage20A baseline code evidence; future manifest-only launch wrapper, not launched at P0

semantic_effect: OFF sets aligned=encoded and aligned_support=reference_support; support supervision therefore receives a different last_aligned_support.

evaluation.reference: V2 TRAIN Black 97 ROI; possible checkpoint-training overlap
evaluation.ROI: bbox plus 25 percent context with frozen floor/ceil clipping

checkpoint_sources.Original_MSDF: Frozen Stage25 Full MSDF Black final_step2000
checkpoint_sources.NoMorph_Black: Experiment 8 independent Black final_step2000 from public SD2 base
checkpoint_sources.Hybrid_Flash: Frozen MSDF gamma=0 Flash Bank A
